summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline using text vectorization, interactions, and a Ridge regression ensemble evaluated via 5-fold CV. However, it critically leaks test data by fitting the StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, and all text vectorizers on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. Additionally, it optimizes and reports RMSE on a log-transformed target, which may not align with the requested RMSE metric on the original scale.
